reviewed_evidence.reason: The DSC 1.2a ICH-vs-predictive decision is the exact downstream consumer of the P-mode bit estimate.
The DSU-VLC section defines residual size and the per-unit prefix/sample bit accounting used by this estimator.
The rate-control output section identifies coded group size as the observable bit-count quantity.
The C body has fixed four-lane storage, three samples per unit, no writes, and a runtime unitsPerGroup bound of three or four.
FindResidualSize, MaxResidualSize, and GetQpAdjPredSize are already PASS components in library/manifest.json; the direct C call chain remains the oracle/reference boundary.

selection.basis: tool-ranked candidate and coverage facts + exact traceability + reviewed domain evidence

admissions.loop: unit < dsc_state->unitsPerGroup with unitsPerGroup in the reviewed {3,4} domain
admissions.proof: The source state is initialized to three units and switches only to four for native 4:2:2; four fixed lanes cover every legal iteration.
Every contracted quantized residual is in [-65535,65535], so the diagnostic branch is unreachable for all legal vectors.
admissions.unreachable_condition: FindResidualSize logging branch requires eq < -131702 || eq > 131701

bounded_loops.loop: unit < dsc_state->unitsPerGroup with unitsPerGroup in the reviewed {3,4} domain

semantics.overflow: No signed overflow occurs on the reviewed DSC 1.2a state/residual domain.
semantics.signedness: All legal source intermediates fit signed 32-bit C int arithmetic; the returned group bit estimate is non-negative.

spec_links.evidence: The PDF model note identifies the encoder ICH/P decision and its P-mode cost input.
The normative decision section is the exact consumer of the estimated predictive-mode bits.
The normative DSU-VLC section defines residual-size and prefix/sample bit accounting.
The normative rate-control output section defines codedBits/rcSizeGroup as bit-count outputs.
The normative residual-size threshold table is delegated to FindResidualSize.
The normative qLevel table is delegated to MapQpToQlevel and its promoted callers.
